bearing_pronunciation: Speak three individual digits, including leading zeroes: heading 280 is heading two eight zero; 045 is zero four five. Preserve numeric captions.
scope: Authored calibration range. Original PC dialogue coverage remains to be recovered.

Commander.style: Seasoned American tank commander. Firm, controlled, concise; natural speech close to a dry microphone.

Gunner.style: American tank gunner. Clear, alert, clipped operational delivery; dry close microphone.

Loader.style: American tank loader working inside a cramped turret. Energetic, physically exerted, short clear calls; dry close microphone.

Driver.style: American tank driver. Low, slightly gravelly, matter of fact and calm; dry close microphone.

ready.caption: Crew ready. Range is clear. Move out.
ready.text: Crew ready. Range is clear. Move out.
ready.direction: Brisk. Perform the three scripted sentences exactly, with punctuation setting the pauses.

on_the_way.caption: On the way!
on_the_way.direction: Immediate, decisive firing call. Quick attack with no introductory pause.

loaded.caption: Up!
loaded.direction: A short, clear readiness call. Speak only the written word, with ordinary pronunciation.

target.caption: Target acquired.
target.direction: Quick factual confirmation, focused rather than excited.

hit.caption: Good hit.
hit.direction: Restrained approval of a training hit, concise and level.

cease_fire.caption: Cease fire. Range complete.
cease_fire.direction: Firm stop order, then a calmer confirmation.

smoke.caption: Smoke out.
smoke.direction: Short tactical confirmation, clear and immediate.

empty.caption: No rounds remaining.
empty.direction: Urgent factual ammunition report, without panic or theatrical shouting.

moving.caption: Moving.
moving.direction: Brief acknowledgement while concentrating on driving.
